greet.speaker: dax
greet.text: You run the Beacon. I run a blade. Vault Orun's seal is failing with forty people behind it and the control got routed through this hole a hundred years ago. I need a crew that goes down and comes back. Rates negotiable. Loyalty isn't.

choices.text: We could use a blade. What's the catch?
[Vault] Orun. I know the seal-song. My vault sang it too.
[Undercity] I've seen your kind of mercenary. Which purge were you on?

catch.speaker: dax
catch.text: The catch is I don't do magic and I don't do causes. Your Weft-witch wants to sing at the Loom, that's her funeral. Mine's forty people and a door. Find me the seal control and I'm yours until it's shut.

choices.text: Sera, you're Ashfound. So is he. Say something.
We don't hire people who spit on the Weft.

sera_say.speaker: sera
sera_say.text: He's no more Ashfound than a rock is. He's just from the same ground. Hire him. Don't trust him with the map.

refused.speaker: dax
refused.text: Still forty people. Still a door. Changed your mind?

recruited.speaker: dax
recruited.text: Seal's still failing. Every hour we spend up here is an hour of air they don't have.

names.speaker: dax
names.text: My sister. Her kids. The old man who taught me the blade. Ask me again after the seal's shut and I'll give you the rest.
